name: Aerath
description: A small city-state in the Blue Mountains of Jamuraa on Dominaria whose people are powerful, brutish warriors.

timeline.summary: During Johan's War, Johan's assassins murder the three Aerathi clan chiefs and the Aerathi are subjugated into Johan's army.
timeline.quote: Johan sent assassins to murder the three Aerathi clan chiefs of the Blue Mountains

citation.text: "Aerath", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Upon Johan's death the Aerathi free themselves from the Northern Realms and become independent.
timeline.quote: the Aerathi freed themselves from the Northern Realms and became independent once more

citation.text: "Aerath", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The kentsu, on Nicol Bolas's order, destroys the Aerathi island nation when it refuses to surrender; survivors are forced into the kentsu.
timeline.quote: the kentsu destroyed the entire island

citation.text: "Aerath", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jorgan Hage kills General Marhault Elsdragon and takes his place as leader of the kentsu.
timeline.quote: Jorgan Hage killed General Marhault Elsdragon and took his place as leader of the kentsu

citation.text: "Aerath", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hage is killed in battle and the Aerathi troops are decimated by Tetsuo Umezawa, Wasitora and Kolo Meha.
timeline.quote: Hage himself was killed in battle

citation.text: "Aerath", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Bolas is killed the Madaran Empire falls into chaos, and remaining Aerathi claim a blood debt with Tetsuo Umezawa and Ayesha Tanaka.
timeline.quote: claimed a blood debt between themselves and Tetsuo Umezawa

citation.text: "Aerath", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: Johan sent assassins to murder the three Aerathi clan chiefs of the Blue Mountains
